note: Both arms read one tree at one path -- the MCP arm's servers read the image's own /data in the run's container, and the mirage /data mount is a copy of it taken out of the same image. The repositories under repos/ are the clones upstream's image makes, at upstream's commits. Notion is the fake both arms read, seeded per run from Atlas's export.
